limits: Native synthetic paused Chromium touch emulation, software-WebGL fallback; not a physical phone certification.

Each act releases contacts and captures live then pauses; automatic approximately3s live or1.2s cumulative FIRE boundaries shorten waits. Inspected timing boundaries and every screenshot before adaptive input.
Paused observations do not establish human reaction time, causal game-quality benefit, continuous held-burst rearming comfort or continuous enjoyment.
Physical phones, Safari, audio and hardware performance unassessed. Source, tests, docs, prior reviews, recordings and internal state not inspected.
Capture automatically releases all contacts; therefore no claim about continuous held-burst rearming across capture or reload.
Pause clears AIM through ordinary lifecycle and closes TOOLS. AIM/TOOLS were not used in these attempts.
Automatic live boundaries were observed on requested3000ms waits, typically executing approximately2967–2988ms; no wait exceeded12100ms and no boundary was bypassed.
Each newly returned screenshot was viewed in a separate tool call before dependent adaptive input. No new scene target chosen after a scene turn without viewing its capture.

scores.scale: 0 unusable; 5 functional with substantial friction; 7 good with noticeable limitations; 9 excellent with minor friction; 10 exceptional. Subjective assessment of observed emulated portrait experience; wins are not the grade. Overall is holistic, not an arithmetic mean.

reasons.overall_mobile: Coherent, atmospheric and completable with accessible touch assistance and strong progress feedback. Portrait target visibility and dependence on offscreen cues reduce confidence; continuous physical play unassessed.
reasons.controls: Large MOVE/FIRE regions supported two-contact movement plus fine fire drags in both runs; scene turns responded. Tap acquisition helpful. Narrow scene and short paused batches limit tracking and rearming comfort assessment.
reasons.gameplay: Observed recovery, patrol combat, coil exposure and deck hold form a clear progression. Route assistance made navigation manageable; observed run was heavily guided and brief, leaving depth and sustained enjoyment unassessed.
reasons.presentation: Distinctive rain-soaked industrial station, coherent teal/amber palette, readable weapon silhouette, polished title and terminal layouts. Audio not assessed.
reasons.usability: Handbook, route/approach labels, planning map, auto reload and explicit end stats reduced guesswork. Initial last-coil entry discovery and route-facing walls created friction.
reasons.readability: Health/ammo/objective/upload feedback readable at390px, but distant silhouettes, clustered brackets, small coil labels and offscreen threats compete for attention.
